settings.name: Pet's name
settings.look_help: Changes show on the forum as soon as you save. Uploaded art (below) replaces the built-in art once the egg has hatched.
settings.growth: How much care it takes to grow
settings.growth_help: Each feed and each play counts as one care. Every member can feed and play once a day.
settings.growth_invalid: Use three whole numbers that go up, starting from 1. Until then the defaults (15, 75, 300) are used.
settings.reset: Start over with a new egg
settings.reset_confirm: Start over? The pet goes back to an egg and today's care is cleared. Past care stays in members' history.
settings.reset_done: A new egg is in the nest.
settings.timezone_help: When "today" starts and ends for feeding and playing, as a timezone name like America/New_York or Europe/Berlin. Unknown names use UTC.
settings.sidebar: Show the pet's card in the sidebar
settings.corner: Show a small pet in the corner wherever the sidebar card isn't showing
settings.corner_help: Phones, pages without the sidebar, and themes that hide it get a little pet in the bottom-left corner that opens its card.
settings.nav: Link to the pet's page in the sidebar menu
settings.art_help: Upload a picture for any mood (PNG, GIF, WebP or JPEG, up to 2 MB, square works best). It replaces the built-in pet in that mood from the baby stage on; the egg stays as drawn. Uploads take effect at once.

errors.forum_pet_upload_too_big: That picture is bigger than 2 MB. Try a smaller one.
errors.forum_pet_upload_not_image: That file isn't a PNG, GIF, WebP or JPEG picture between 16 and 4096 pixels wide. SVG isn't accepted.
errors.forum_pet_upload_failed: The picture couldn't be uploaded. Try again.
